name: Jarvis for AI Agents
author: Jim Burchel
description: A voice for the AI agent in your terminal: Claude Code, Codex and Gemini CLI read their replies aloud with free neural voices. Say "Hey Jarvis" to dictate your answer hands-free, and hush it with one key. Bar widget shows speaking, listening and muted.

barWidget.description: Voice assistant state — click to mute, right-click to hush, middle-click to toggle wake word
